old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a black frying pan on what appears to be a stovetop. The focus is on a small square of butter placed at the center of the pan. As the video progresses, the butter begins to melt, creating a pool of liquid around it. The surface of the butter starts to bubble slightly, indicating the beginning stages of melting. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent angle that centers on the butter and the pan's interior. The lighting is focused on the pan, highlighting the texture and movement of the melting butter. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, and the background remains out of focus, ensuring all attention is on the transformation of the butter.

caption: The video captures a close-up, fixed view of a dark non-stick pan, where a small square pat of pale butter sits at the center, partly encircled by a pool of melted, yellowish butter. The melting is underway from the first frame, the liquid pool ringed by white foam and scattered bubbles. These bubbles continuously appear, pop, and re-form along the rim, showing steady simmering. The solid pat holds its central position throughout, never translating or vanishing within the excerpt. Its crisp corners look marginally softer as the boundary dissolves, though the bulk remains intact. Tiny droplets dot the pan surface, and a blurred highlight runs along the out-of-focus far rim, while a dark blob rests at the top edge. The camera stays stationary, so all visible change is physical rather than a shift in viewpoint. The clip ends with the pat still solid and the foaming still active, leaving the outcome unresolved.
